name: Configure and operate physical hardware devices
description: Users sought step-by-step instructions to configure, connect, or operate specific physical hardware devices, single-board computers, and embedded systems. The requests often involved troubleshooting initial setup, implementing device-to-device communication links, or adjusting peripheral settings for cameras, printers, and audio-visual displays.
